## What and why

## Verification

- [ ] `python scripts/run_tests.py` (record counts and runtime)
- [ ] Relevant failing test reproduced before the change
- [ ] Examples and API contracts updated
- [ ] Package/installed-CLI checks for packaging or public-API changes
